title: February 27, 2017 Austin Energy Utility Oversight Committee Regular Meeting
meeting_type: Austin Energy Utility Oversight Committee Regular Meeting
transcript:
THE AUSTIN ENERGY UTILITY OVERSIGHT COMMITTEE WILL MEET  
ON MONDAY, FEBRUARY 27, 2017 AT 9:30 AM, AUSTIN CITY HALL 
301 W. SECOND STREET 
AUSTIN, TEXAS 
 
 
Leslie Pool, Chair 
Alison Alter  
Ora Houston 
Delia Garza  
Sabino “Pio” Renteria 
 
Steve Adler, Vice Chair 
Gregorio Casar 
 Ann Kitchen 
Jimmy Flannigan 
Ellen Troxclair 
Kathie Tovo 
 
 
AGENDA 
 
 
The Austin Energy Utility Oversight Committee consists of a quorum of the City Council. However, 
no action will be taken except as the Austin Energy Utility Oversight Committee.  
 
The Austin Energy Utility Oversight Committee may go into a closed session on any item on this 
agenda under Texas Government Code Section 551.071 to receive advice from legal counsel or 
Section 551.086 to discuss utility competitive matters. 
 
CALL TO ORDER 
 
 
Approval of Minutes 
 
1. 
Approve the minutes of the Austin Energy Utility Oversight Committee 
meeting of January 30, 2017. 
 
 
Citizen Communication: General 
 
2. 
The first five speakers signed up before the meeting is called to order will 
each be allowed three minutes to speak on items not on the agenda. 
 
 
Discussion and Possible Action 
 
 
 
3. 
General Manager’s report: 
• Austin Energy Regional Science Festival,  
• Dell Seton Medical Center energy efficiency rebate, 
• upcoming procurements: residential and commercial electric meters, 
information technology hardware and software. 
(Notes: SPONSOR: Council Member Leslie Pool, CO 1: Mayor Steve Adler, 
CO 2: Mayor Pro Tem Kathie Tovo ) 
 
4. 
Discussion of the Customer Collaboration section of the Austin Energy 
Monthly Performance Dashboard related to customer account services. 
(Notes: SPONSOR: Council Member Leslie Pool, CO 1: Mayor Steve Adler, 
CO 2: Mayor Pro Tem Kathie Tovo) 
 
5. 
Update regarding the collections process, including payment arrangements 
and disconnections. 
(Notes: SPONSOR: Council Member Leslie Pool, CO 1: Mayor Steve Adler, 
CO 2: Mayor Pro Tem Kathie Tovo) 
 
6. 
Update regarding arrearage management. 
(Notes: SPONSOR: Council Member Leslie Pool, CO 1: Mayor Steve Adler, 
CO 2: Mayor Pro Tem Kathie Tovo) 
 
 
Future Items 
 
7. 
Identify items to discuss at future meetings. 
 
ADJOURN 
 
 
 
 
The City of Austin is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. 
Reasonable modifications and equal access to communications will be provided upon request. 
For assistance, please call 512-974-2210 or TTY users route through 711.  
 
A person may request a Spanish language interpreter be made available by contacting the Office of 
the City Clerk not later than twenty-four hours before the scheduled time of the item on which the 
person wishes to speak.  Please call (512) 974-2210 in advance or inform the City Clerk’s staff 
present at the council meeting. 
 
Cualquier persona puede solicitar servicios de intérprete en español comunicándose con la oficina del 
Secretario/a Municipal a no más tardar de veinte y cuatro  horas antes de la hora determinada para el 
asunto sobre el cual la persona desea comentar. Por favor llame al (512) 974-2210 con anticipo o 
informe al personal del Secretario/a Municipal presente en la sesión del Consejo.
